name: strong-squid
description: A day-to-night switch whose sun slides into a cratered moon while clouds drop and stars rise.
purpose: Lets people flip a persistent on/off setting when the control itself should telegraph day versus night.
bestFor: settings rows that need a memorable binary control
avoidFor: forms that need a plain unlabeled checkbox
